verdict.rationale: TaxJar is a sales-tax SaaS service, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a REST API with API-key auth and language client libraries. None of it mentions an MCP server, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
